headline: Same index, different results?
sub: What to compare before choosing an index fund

cards.label: Costs
cards.body: Funds tracking the same index can charge different fees.

cards.label: Method
cards.body: Some hold every stock in the index; others hold a sample.

cards.label: Tracking
cards.body: Fees and trading costs can make a fund lag its index.

footer: Read the prospectus, not just the fund name
